description: Models sequential keyboard navigation for WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order, 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks, 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value. Pass `markup` (HTML with optional style blocks). Returns the numbered Tab sequence with guessed accessible names (aria-label, label, text, alt, title), the elements left out (hidden, inert, tabindex -1), and findings: positive tabindex, focusable elements inside aria-hidden, onclick on non-interactive elements, controls with no name, no skip link, outline: none without a replacement, and dialogs that need manual testing. It is a model of the browser rule from attributes, not a recording; Reads the pasted source only; nothing is rendered or run, stored or logged.

markup.description: HTML of the page or component.
